# Kalpanaaaa Software Solutions

> Bespoke engineering partner for government, healthcare, finance, and education. Jaipur, India.

## Services
- Full-Stack Web Engineering (Next.js, React, Node.js, GraphQL/REST, PostgreSQL, Redis)
- Omnichannel Mobile Apps (React Native, Swift, Kotlin, offline-first)
- Cloud DevOps & Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD)
- Enterprise Quality Assurance (Playwright, Vitest, k6, axe-core, 100% coverage)
- RAG Systems & AI Engineering (LangChain, LlamaIndex, pgvector, Pinecone, OpenAI, Anthropic)
- Multi-Agent Automation (LangGraph, CrewAI, LangSmith, human-in-the-loop)

## Industries
- Government: G2C compliance, digital portals, licensing workflows
- Healthcare: HIPAA-aligned platforms, EHR integration, telemedicine
- Finance: Trading systems, settlement, RBI/SEBI compliance, fraud detection
- Education: LMS, SIS, adaptive learning, campus management

## Case Studies
- RailTrace: Real-time railway asset tracking (99.97% uptime, 200+ assets, 40% permit reduction)
- MediChain: HIPAA-aligned patient data platform (50,000+ records)
- KUCafe: University cafe ordering (12,000+ orders, 96% satisfaction)
